name: Venomweb Vale
summary: South of the Scarlet Monastery, Venomweb Vale lies blighted beneath a swarm of venomous spiders. The valley was once a lush woodland where hunters tracked deer and rabbits.

sections.title: A Blighted Refuge
sections.body: Venomweb Vale has fallen from a peaceful hunting ground to a blighted refuge. Before the plague consumed Lordaeron, local hunters followed deer and rabbits through its grass and trees. Now rot and gloom cover the valley, while giant venomous spiders swarm through the trees and hollows. The monstrous arachnid Sri'skulk leads them. To the north, the Scarlet Crusade holds the neighboring territory. Darkhounds prowl near the fortified Scarlet Encampment, where Lieutenant Sanders commands.

faq.q: Why are there so many spiders in Venomweb Vale?
faq.answer: Venomweb Vale was once a hunting ground for deer and rabbits, but the valley is now overrun by poisonous spiders led by Sri'skulk. Their deadly webs and venom gave the vale its name.

faq.q: Who rules the arachnids in the vale?
faq.answer: Sri'skulk leads the spider brood in Venomweb Vale, stalking the hollows beneath its blighted canopy.

angles.text: As a Forsaken traveler heading toward the Scarlet Monastery, you must navigate Sri'skulk's lethal brood and the watchful Crusader patrols led by Lieutenant Sanders to the north.
